title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
slides: Anthropic wants to scan your open-source code for free.
They're offering free AI security scans to any project.
But the scanner can't catch everything human reviewers do.
You can sign up and scan your repo tomorrow.
One repo scan this week: see what it misses.
thread_text:
1. Free Code Scans

Anthropic just opened free AI security scans to any open-source project. But their own scanner admits it can't catch what human reviewers do.

2. What It Misses

The tool flags common vulnerabilities, but skips logic flaws and subtle backdoors. Those still need a human eye.

3. Sign Up Tomorrow

You can enroll your repo starting tomorrow. No cost, no catch — just a limited view of your code's weak spots.

4. One Repo Test

This week, run one scan on a repo you maintain. Compare its findings to what your team already knows.

5. Your Turn

Does a free scan save you time if you still need to verify every alert? Try it on a side project and see.

Ask yourself: does it save time or create more work?
